description: Capture AFTER evidence proving the WS4 acceptance criteria and write the walkthrough the orchestrator needs for the PR description. Uses the FEAT-001 harness against the FEAT-002 build. Depends on FEAT-002.
steps: Run the viewport harness for all five routes at BOTH 390x844 and 1280x900 against the built out/, writing PNG + JSON under docs/a11y/after-*. Confirm every JSON reports noHorizontalScroll:true (scrollWidth<=innerWidth) at both widths.

Capture reduced-motion evidence: run the harness (or a small variant) once with the emulated media feature prefers-reduced-motion=reduce and once with no-preference, on at least one 3D demo and the landing page, saving before/after-style stills under docs/a11y/ that show ambient/idle motion and CSS animations damped when reduced motion is on. Playwright supports context/page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion:'reduce' }); wire that into the harness via a flag. If deterministic stills cannot show the difference, additionally document the code paths gated and cite that emulateMedia toggled the hook.

Write docs/a11y/AFTER.md containing: the machine/runtime + browser; a per-route table of scrollWidth vs innerWidth at both widths (all <= width); the meaningful aria-label text for each of the four canvases; how prefers-reduced-motion is wired (the shared hook + the CSS media query) and exactly what it disables/damps (camera nudges, ambient particles, avatar idle bob/sway, wardrobe autoRotate, landing CSS animations) with confirmation motion returns when off; and confirmation WS1/WS2/WS3 wins are preserved and HOW verified.

Write docs/a11y/KEYBOARD.md: the end-to-end keyboard-path walkthrough PER WIDGET (chef, coach: composer input -> chips -> Send, plus mute + QualityToggle; pet: Feed/Play/Sleep/Clean -> name input -> Save, plus QualityToggle; wardrobe: option cards -> swatches -> custom-colour -> animation radios, plus QualityToggle), noting the visible focus indicator and, for the WS3 clickable props, the keyboard/AT-reachable equivalent (chef 'Suggest a recipe' chip, pet 'Play' button, wardrobe option cards).
Optionally write docs/a11y/DIFF.md summarizing before vs after per route (scroll fixed, panel no longer covering canvas). List all files changed in the workstream.

Commit the docs/a11y AFTER evidence + markdown (and any harness tweak needed for emulateMedia). Do NOT commit node_modules/, .next/, out/, or assets-src/. Message like `docs(a11y): WS4 AFTER evidence, keyboard walkthrough, reduced-motion proof`.
acceptance_criteria: docs/a11y/ contains AFTER screenshots + JSON for all five routes at BOTH 390x844 and 1280x900, every JSON noHorizontalScroll:true.

docs/a11y/AFTER.md states machine/browser, the per-route scroll table (all <= width), each canvas's aria-label, the reduced-motion wiring and what it damps (with motion returning when off), and how WS1/WS2/WS3 wins were verified preserved.
docs/a11y/KEYBOARD.md walks the keyboard path end-to-end per widget with visible focus and the WS3 clickable-prop keyboard equivalents.
Reduced-motion is demonstrated via emulated media (reduce vs no-preference) evidence under docs/a11y/.
No node_modules/, .next/, out/, or assets-src/ committed.
verification: export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH" && npm run build then re-run the harness; confirm all ten (5 routes x 2 widths) JSON reports show noHorizontalScroll:true.
Confirm docs/a11y/AFTER.md and docs/a11y/KEYBOARD.md exist and are populated with the required tables/walkthrough.
git status shows only docs/a11y + harness changes staged; no build output or node_modules.
